cases.name: head-clean
cases.description: A head the pinned relay signed.

cases.name: head-empty
cases.description: No revocations for the delegator: positive absence evidence.

cases.name: head-wrong-key
cases.description: Signed by a relay key other than the pinned one.

cases.name: head-bad-signature
cases.description: as_of changed after signing.

cases.name: head-malformed-signature
cases.description: Signature is not 64 base64url bytes.

cases.name: head-challenge-mismatch
cases.description: Answers another consumer's challenge.

cases.name: head-delegator-mismatch
cases.description: Covers another delegator.

cases.name: head-foreign-entry
cases.description: Carries an entry for another delegator (forged).

cases.name: head-out-of-order
cases.description: Entries not strictly ascending by seq (forged).

cases.name: head-seq-above-high-water
cases.description: An entry seq exceeds seq_high_water (forged).

cases.name: head-count-mismatch
cases.description: count disagrees with entries (forged).

cases.name: head-digest-mismatch
cases.description: records_digest disagrees with entries (forged).

cases.name: head-stale
cases.description: as_of older than window (60 s) plus skew (60 s).

cases.name: head-stale-boundary
cases.description: as_of exactly window plus skew old: accepted.

cases.name: head-future
cases.description: as_of more than skew (60 s) in the future.

cases.name: head-rollback
cases.description: seq_high_water below one already accepted from this relay key.

cases.name: head-unsupported-spec
cases.description: A receipt's spec discriminator on a head body.

cases.name: receipt-clean
cases.description: The pinned relay receipted the submitted revocation.

cases.name: receipt-wrong-key
cases.description: Receipted by another relay key.

cases.name: receipt-bad-signature
cases.description: seq changed after signing.

cases.name: receipt-other-revocation
cases.description: Names a revocation other than the one submitted.

cases.name: omission-detected
cases.description: Receipt at seq 9; a later head at high-water 10 lacks the record.

cases.name: omission-wrong-seq
cases.description: Head carries the record, but at a seq other than receipted.

cases.name: omission-carried
cases.description: Head carries the receipted record.

cases.name: omission-not-covered
cases.description: Head high-water below the receipted seq.

cases.name: omission-other-relay
cases.description: Receipt and head signed by different relay keys.

cases.name: omission-forged-receipt
cases.description: Receipt signature does not verify.

cases.name: equivocation-detected
cases.description: Same key, delegator and high-water; different records_digest.

cases.name: equivocation-same-entries
cases.description: Same entries under different challenge and as_of: same digest.

cases.name: equivocation-different-high-water
cases.description: Different seq_high_water.

cases.name: equivocation-forged
cases.description: One head's signature does not verify.
